中文原文: 一直用手機拍照，直到朋友借我一台全幅機去街拍一下午。
英文翻譯: I kept taking photos with my phone until a friend lent me a full-frame camera for an afternoon of street photography.

中文原文: 對焦速度和夜拍的乾淨程度讓我回不去。
英文翻譯: The focusing speed and the cleanliness of night shots made me unable to go back to my phone camera.

中文原文: 隔週就下訂了同款的二手機身，鏡頭先買一顆定焦。
英文翻譯: A week later, I placed an order for a second-hand body of the same model, and first purchased a prime lens.
